title: Stardew Valley Costs You 28¢ an Hour. Worth It?
caption:
Stardew Valley is $14.99 on Steam and takes about 53 hours to beat (HowLongToBeat main story): 28 cents an hour. A $12 movie ticket for 2 hours is $6 an hour. Go 100% (about 173 hours) and it drops to 9 cents an hour. Our own math.
How many hours have you got in Stardew?

Sources: Steam store (US price), HowLongToBeat
ig_first_line: A movie costs you $6 an hour. Stardew Valley costs 28 cents. Go 100% and it's 9 cents.
